hook: Models project 31 major tree pests and pathogens shifting north, threatening boreal forests by 2041 to 2080.
summary: Species distribution models for 31 damaging tree pests and pathogens predict a consistent northward shift under climate scenarios, raising risk in northern temperate and boreal forests and lowering it in places like southern Europe. Temperature and precipitation of the warmest quarter and driest month were key drivers. These models use climate suitability alone and do not simulate dispersal, host availability or control.
title: Climate change drives northward range shifts in invasive forest pests and pathogens
